title: Leo's Collapsing Wooden Castle: Mistakes Help Us Grow!

lines.text: Leo spent two hours carefully balancing wooden blocks into a magnificent twenty-story castle!
lines.caps: Leo spent two hours carefully balancing wooden blocks into a magnificent twenty-story *CASTLE!

lines.text: He reached for the final golden spire at the very top... CRASH! The tower collapsed!
lines.caps: He reached for the final golden spire at the very top... *CRASH! | The tower *COLLAPSED!

lines.text: Blocks scattered in every direction! Leo felt hot tears in his eyes and wanted to stomp them!
lines.caps: Blocks scattered in every direction! Leo felt hot tears in his eyes and wanted to *STOMP | *THEM!

lines.text: His grandfather knelt beside the wooden rubble and asked, What did the blocks teach you?
lines.caps: His grandfather knelt beside the wooden rubble and asked, What did the blocks *TEACH | *YOU?

lines.text: Leo looked at the floor: the base was narrow and thin like a pencil!
lines.caps: Leo looked at the floor: the base was narrow and thin like a *PENCIL!

lines.text: Castles need a wide, rock-solid foundation to hold up heavy grand towers above!
lines.caps: Castles need a wide, rock-solid foundation to hold up heavy grand *TOWERS | *ABOVE!

lines.text: Leo laid down eight wide blocks on the carpet, rebuilding the strongest castle in history!
lines.caps: Leo laid down eight wide blocks on the carpet, rebuilding the strongest *CASTLE | in *HISTORY!

lines.text: Mistakes are not failures—they are secret clues that show you how to build better next time!
lines.caps: Mistakes are not failures—they are secret clues that show you how to build *BETTER | next *TIME!
